status: Prospective local lock for USC-HAD only; all six preceding datasets are development/reanalysis, not fresh confirmation
method: Horizon-calibrated finite-pool reference-set emulation with label-free finite-batch cardinality stopping
reference_pool: Use all calibration participants. N=min(ceiling,120*m). Quotas differ by at most one, extra quotas assigned by a random participant permutation. Uniformly sample quota windows without using their labels. Then uniformly permute all N selected windows for label queries.
monitor_batch: All held-out test inputs and model probability vectors, with test labels hidden until evaluation. This is a transductive finite-batch set-size guarantee. Set containment on the confidence event holds for every input, beyond that batch; size inflation beyond the batch is not guaranteed.
cost: Primary outcome counts queried window labels. Secondary modeled effort is t+c*m with c=0,10,30,100; charge every reference participant's setup even if no label has yet been queried. No measured annotation time or savings in raw segmentation is claimed.
backbones: Reuse all 249 V5 model cases for development. New USC-HAD uses the unchanged V5 LR/MR/IT implementations. IT is one network, not the canonical five-network ensemble. Only one final fit per USC partition is required; no OOF planning models are used by this method.
preprocessing: Each USC-HAD MAT trial is separate, 5-second nonoverlapping acceleration windows, discard incomplete tails and nonfinite windows, anti-aliased resample_poly to 128 time points with line padding; map activity IDs 1-12 to 0-11. Check original file schema and recorded frequency before training. No test-selected resampling, classes, exclusions or training checkpoints.
comparators: Waudby-Smith and Ramdas prior/posterior-ratio rank CS with uniform population-count prior
fixed 50 percent one-look hypergeometric upper bound
ablations: quantile midpoint at the proposed stopping time (diagnostic, no containment guarantee)
sparse checkpoint schedule using the same exact horizon engine
sensitivity: delta=0.01,0.1,0.2 on old six datasets only; monitor transfer from even to odd held-out input indices on old six datasets only; report as exploratory, never extend finite-batch size guarantees to the other batch
aggregation: Average query randomizations and repetitions within subjects, then equal-weight subjects. Campaign-level rank/containment/inflation failures counted once per pool/query run, not duplicated per test subject. Uncertainty intervals use paired subject resampling conditional on fitted models and partitions; do not treat random draws as independent human participants.
boundary_calibration: Joint absorbing DP state (number of sampled ranks <k, whether rank k has been sampled); choose common hypergeometric tail level by 24-step monotone bisection with exact crossing mass <=delta-1e-10. Boundaries depend only on N, alpha, delta and prespecified checkpoints. If running brackets become empty, revert to the current bracket and record the event; guarantee uses simultaneous original brackets. Return exact full quantile at census.
theory_scope: At probability at least 1-delta over uniform label-query order, all returned sets contain their full-pool reference sets and average extra labels on the unlabeled monitor batch are <=tolerance. No new 90-percent marginal coverage guarantee for dependent/shifted users, no claim of invented hypergeometric intervals or sequential testing, no global optimality claim.
readiness_criteria: Require verified math/code, fresh confirmation, paired improvement over both safe baselines, visible limits on weak models, accurate closest-literature positioning, complete source/format audit. A failed efficiency result is retained and is not remedied by changing the locked tolerance. No acceptance guarantee.
